Indikator 2 measures the proportion of patients who receive a CT scan within two hours of arrival at the hospital, evaluated across Danish regions and specific hospitals. According to the 2024 data, performance is universally poor, with no region or hospital meeting the established development target of ≥ 90% [^src1]. Every evaluated unit failed to meet the target, as indicated by the "Nej" (No) status in the compliance column [^src1].

At the regional level, [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] leads the comparison with the highest proportion of patients scanned within the two-hour window at 41.8% [^src1]. Conversely, the Region of Zealand (Sjælland) trails among the regions with a compliance rate of just 25.9% [^src1]. The national average for Denmark stands at 32.4% [^src1]. Other regions, including the Capital Region (Hovedstaden) at 33.0%, [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] at 28.5%, and the North Denmark Region (Nordjylland) at 28.5%, all cluster in the upper twenties to low thirties [^src1].

When examining individual hospitals, [[regionshospitalet-randers|Regionshospitalet Randers]] emerges as the clear leader, achieving the highest overall rate at 48.8% [^src1]. [[regionshospital-nordjylland|Regionshospital Nordjylland]] also performs relatively well at 44.1% [^src1]. However, [[aalborg-universitetshospital|Aalborg Universitetshospital]] trails significantly at 17.8% [^src1]. A major outlier in the dataset is Aalborg Universitetshospital, Thisted, which recorded a 0.0% compliance rate with a confidence interval of 0.0, and notably lacks the standard "Nej" text in the target fulfillment column, displaying "0,0" instead [^src1].

Because the provided data consists of only a single dated section from 2024, no longitudinal trends, improvements, or declines can be determined for Indikator 2 [^src1].

Entities: region-syddanmark, region-midtjylland, regionshospitalet-randers, aalborg-universitetshospital, regionshospital-nordjylland

Summary: Tabellen sammenligner andelen af patienter, der fik CT-skanning inden for to timer efter ankomst, på regionalt og hospitalsniveau, og viser at ingen enheder nåede udviklingsmålet på ≥ 90 %, med værdier mellem 0,0 % (Aalborg Universitetshospital, Thisted) og 48,8 % (Regionshospitalet Randers).
